exercises.title: Clothing Styles
exercises.instructions: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.content:
Exercise: Clothing Styles – Seasons and Events

Instructions: Choose the correct answer.

1.) In winter, we wear a __________ to keep warm. (coat / T-shirt)
(En hiver, nous portons un manteau pour avoir chaud.)

2.) In summer, I like wearing a __________ because the weather is hot. (T-shirt / coat)
(En été, j’aime porter un T-shirt parce qu’il fait chaud.)

3.) When it is raining, we can wear a __________. (raincoat / swimsuit)
(Quand il pleut, nous pouvons porter un imperméable.)

4.) At school, pupils usually wear a __________. (school uniform / swimsuit)
(À l’école, les élèves portent généralement un uniforme scolaire.)

5.) At a wedding, people can wear __________ clothes. (smart / dirty)
(À un mariage, les gens peuvent porter des vêtements élégants.)

6.) When we go to the beach, we can wear a __________. (swimsuit / winter coat)
(Quand nous allons à la plage, nous pouvons porter un maillot de bain.)

7.) In cold weather, we can wear __________ to keep our hands warm. (gloves / sandals)
(Quand il fait froid, nous pouvons porter des gants pour garder nos mains au chaud.)

8.) At a sports activity, we should wear __________ clothes. (sportswear / formal)
(Pour une activité sportive, nous devons porter des vêtements de sport.)

9.) At a birthday party, you can wear __________ clothes. (nice / dirty)
(À une fête d’anniversaire, tu peux porter de beaux vêtements.)

10.) In hot weather, we can wear __________ to protect our eyes from the sun. (sunglasses / gloves)
(Quand il fait chaud, nous pouvons porter des lunettes de soleil pour protéger nos yeux du soleil.)

My name is Lily. I choose my clothes according to the season and the event. In summer, I wear a light dress and sandals because the weather is hot. In winter, I wear a coat, trousers and warm shoes. For a birthday party, I like wearing a nice dress. When I go to school, I wear my school uniform. I always choose clothes that are suitable for the place and the occasion.
